as_told.title: ODNI's hieroglyph-on-a-UFO claim leaked to Jeremy Corbell

plain: Dylan Borland, a former government official, is said to have made a drawing of a hieroglyph-like symbol, reportedly one seen on a UFO, while giving testimony to the US intelligence agencies' watchdog. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, which oversees US spy agencies, told him this, and Michels repeats it to Borland, saying the drawings were made for that office. Borland answers in 2026 that this is only Corbell's account, built on what he calls an illegal leak to Corbell from someone in that office's inspector general, and treats the symbol as hypothetical.
